5.1: the first stable release of 5.1

Everything from the 5.1 betas, up to and including beta 8.6, plus these fixes and one new scripting feature.
The in-game update checker now offers this version.

**New: scripts can react to chat**
- `chatSeen("text")` is true when a chat message containing that text arrives. Capitals and colours are ignored,
  and each message counts once, so `if (chatSeen("has requested to teleport")) { command("/tpaccept"); }` in a
  loop accepts every request exactly once.
- `waitForChat("text", seconds)` waits for such a message and returns the whole line, or `null` after `seconds`.
- `lastChat()` returns the newest message.
- Blocks: **Wait for a chat message** and **If chat said**.
- Scripts only see chat from after they started. Player chat shows as `<Name> message`.

**Fixes**
- **Walk to a waypoint** / `gotoWaypoint("home")` went to the wrong place or nowhere: Baritone reads `home`, `base`,
  `death`, `bed` and `spawn` as tags, so a waypoint you named `home` was never used. A waypoint with that name now
  wins, then the newest waypoint with that tag. Two waypoints with the same name pick the newest instead of doing
  nothing, and it returns false if you didn't arrive.
- `inventoryFull(item)` and `roomFor(item)` counted every empty slot as room for 64, which was wrong for items that
  stack to 16 (ender pearls) or 1 (tools).
- `random(min, max)` crashed when `max` was 2147483647.
- Server profiles with a port and a wildcard, like `*.example.com:25566` or `*:25566`, never matched.

Fabric only, Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3.
